response.sql: SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.DNA) AS avg_anti_dna, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_albumin_minus_total_protein FROM Laboratory AS l INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` = 180 GROUP BY p.SEX;

assumptions.assumption: Interpreted “screened with 180 as the total cholesterol cutoff” as requiring T-CHO to equal 180. The request could also mean T-CHO is at or below 180 (or above 180); that cutoff direction is unspecified.

alternatives.interpretation: Use 180 as an upper bound, including values equal to 180.
alternatives.sql: SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.DNA) AS avg_anti_dna, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_albumin_minus_total_protein FROM Laboratory AS l INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` <= 180 GROUP BY p.SEX;
